bounded_question: How does node #115 Find a component through the sibling entry point 0x609a740: the flag-chain node resolution, the name dispatch (exact name, 'id', the '.id' suffix, the node-name-plus-dot compare), the '=' / ';' helper 0x6099e70, the no-'=' helper 0x609ba30, the kind dispatcher 0x609b700 with its recursive kind-0x16 call, the element scan 0x6096f40 and the name lookup 0x60ba0b0 with its dotted-name fallback -- and what does each step report when the name cannot be resolved?

delegate_impl.behaviour: Calls the object's vtable slot 0x48 with (out, obj, value, ctx_map, flag); reached from fallback_delegate 0x6097150 (flag 0) and from find_e70 0x6099e70 at 0x609a032 (flag 0). Re-shipped byte-identical from #3485.

descriptor.behaviour: The node descriptor the entry resolves: base8 + the +0x00 offset is the node address; the +0xb0 flags 0x200/0x400/0x800 (any one set) follow the address through one pointer load, matching the flag-chain shape of the matcher in #3485; the +0xb1 bit 0 clears the value copy's +0x04 byte and selects the clearing dispatch.
descriptor.layout: {i64 offset +0x00, u32 flags +0xb0, u8 flag +0xb1} (at least 0xb2 bytes; the full extent is not pinned)

element.layout: {name pointer +0x00, name length +0x08, 16 bytes +0x20, table pointer +0x28} (0x30 bytes)
element.notes: The +0x20 field (8 bytes stored into the scan's found_out) is passed as kind_dispatch's extra argument and, on the recursive kind-0x16 path, as the entry's base8 argument.

element_scan.behaviour: Walks the 0x30-byte elements of the vector at node+0x08 (begin +0x00, end +0x08, stride 0x30). Per element the name string at +0x00/+0x08 is copied; when the element's +0x28 pointer is non-null the name lookup 0x60ba0b0 runs with (key, element+0x28, out3); on a non-null lookup result the element's +0x20 field (8 bytes) is stored into found_out and the lookup result is returned. When no element matches, null is returned. The scan returns the lookup result itself (a pointer to the matched node's +0x28 field), not a boolean.

ends_with.behaviour: Returns 1 when the suffix string's length is <= the haystack's length and the haystack's last len(suffix) bytes equal the suffix (memcmp at haystack.ptr + haystack.len - suffix.len); 0 when the suffix is longer. An empty suffix returns 1. The entry uses it for the '.id' suffix (the temp string is built inline as bytes 0x2e 0x69 0x64, length 3).

entry.behaviour: The sibling Find entry point. (1) Node resolution: when base8 is null the node is null; otherwise the node address is base8 + the i64 at desc+0x00, and when any of the flags at desc+0xb0 (0x200/0x400/0x800) is set the address is followed through one pointer load. (2) The 0x50-byte value struct is copied (name string deep-copied, the +0x48 control use-count incremented; the copy is released on every exit path). (3) When desc+0xb1 bit 0 is set, the copy's +0x04 byte is cleared; then the name dispatch runs: name5 == key6 -> the delegate's slot-0x50; key6 == 'id' (length 2, first two bytes 0x6469) -> slot-0x50; otherwise the '.id' path. When desc+0xb1 bit 0 is clear and the value's +0x04 byte is 0, the same dispatch runs without the clearing. When desc+0xb1 bit 0 is clear and +0x04 is non-zero, a non-null node takes the '.id' variant-2 path, while a null node with a non-empty arg7 reports Status code 4 'Option not changeable: ' + name5 and a null node with an empty arg7 clears out and returns success. (4) The '.id' path (variant 1): name5 ends with '.id' (0x61d1390) -> slot-0x50; arg7 empty -> clear out, success; node null -> slot-0x50; otherwise the node's slot-0x78 name plus '.' is compared with key6 (0x61d13e0): unequal -> slot-0x50; equal -> if arg7 contains '=' the '=' helper 0x6099e70 runs, else the no-'=' helper 0x609ba30 runs. (5) The '.id' path (variant 2): name5 ends with '.id', or key6 == 'id' -> the node-name compare: the node's slot-0x78 name is compared with arg7; equal -> when the parsed map is empty clear out and return success, otherwise the fallback delegate 0x6097150 runs (delegate_impl with the value copy and the map); unequal -> Status code 4 'Option not changeable: ' + name5. name5 == key6 (and neither of the above) -> the find_norm path: an empty options map and an empty out-string are built, the node's slot-0x78 name is the fallback, find_norm 0x609a410 runs on arg7; a non-zero find_norm status is copied into out and returned; on success the slot-0x78 name is fetched again and compared with find_norm's out-string: equal -> the map-empty check above, unequal -> the code-4 error. Otherwise (name5 != key6, not 'id', no '.id' suffix) -> the no-'=' helper 0x609ba30. (6) The slot-0x50 call is slot(out, delegate, value-copy, desc, key6, arg7, base8) through the delegate's vtable. The entry has exactly one direct call site in the binary (0x609b80f inside kind_dispatch 0x609b700, the recursive kind-0x16 call); its top-level reach is through an indirect slot that is not pinned here.
entry.signature: entry(out, value, delegate, desc, name5, key6, arg7, base8)

fallback_delegate.behaviour: Calls delegate_impl 0x6097110 (out, obj, value, ctx_map) with the flag argument 0. Re-shipped byte-identical from #3485; the extra (value, ctx_map) arguments pass through to the slot-0x48 virtual untouched.

find_e70.behaviour: The '=' / ';' helper. Out is zeroed at entry. When arg7 is empty, or after the steps below leave out with code 0, the value's +0x03 byte is checked: 0 -> return; non-zero -> the node's vtable slot 0x28 fills a temp Status from (node, value) and the temp is moved into out. When arg7 is non-empty: a ';' (0x3b) or an '=' (0x3d) anywhere in arg7 takes the parse path -- a fresh empty options map is built (buckets = its single-bucket slot, count 1, before-begin 0, element count 0, max load factor 1.0), the parser 0x60c1190 runs on arg7 into that map, the parser Status is moved into out, and only on parser success (code 0) the delegate implementation 0x6097110 runs with (node, value, map, flag 0), i.e. the node's vtable slot 0x48; the map is then destroyed via 0x5d5b300. When arg7 has neither ';' nor '=': the node's vtable slot 0x40 is compared with the zero stub 0x60956f0; when it IS the stub, out is zeroed outright (code 0, all six status bytes 0, message null); otherwise slot 0x40 fills a temp Status from (node, value) and the six bytes plus the message pointer are copied into out, and a non-zero code returns at once. The zero-stub comparison is a lea of 0x60956f0 at 0x609a0d7, the only lea reference to the stub in the binary.

find_norm.behaviour: Re-shipped byte-identical from #3485. Correction to that packet's record: the argument order is (out, name, fallback, out-string, ctx-map) -- the 4th argument (rcx) is the out-string and the 5th (r8) is the ctx-map, as the parser call (rdx = r8) and the _M_assign call (rdi = rcx) inside find_norm show. The entry calls it at 0x609b190 with (temp Status, arg7, the slot-0x78 node name, the empty out-string at -0xd0, the empty options map at -0x110). Semantics unchanged from #3485: empty/default name -> the fallback; no '=' -> the name; otherwise the parser runs and a parser failure assigns the name, clears the map and resets out to success; on success the 'id' key is looked up, erased when found, and the out-string is cleared when it equals the default name.

hash_name_find.behaviour: The >20-element path of the name lookup: _Hash_bytes(key, len, 0xc70f6907) % the table's bucket count selects the bucket; the bucket chain is walked comparing the stored hash at node+0xe0, then the name length at node+0x10, then memcmp on node+0x08. A node whose hash falls in a different bucket ends the walk (returns null). On a match the matched node's +0x00 field (its next pointer) is returned -- the caller treats a non-null return as the match; null means no match.

kind_dispatch.behaviour: Kind dispatch on the matched record (kind = the u32 at found+0xa8, i.e. the matched node+0xd0). Kind 0x16 recurses into the sibling entry 0x609a740 with (out, value, node, found, str_b, str_b, arg7, extra). Otherwise, when str_a equals str_b (length, then memcmp) the node's vtable slot 0x50 is called with (out, node, value, found, str_b, arg7, extra). Otherwise kind 0x13 or 0x15 takes the same slot-0x50 call, and any other kind builds Status code 1 with msg1 'Could not find option: ' and msg2 = str_b. The slot-0x50 call passes the object in rsi (the delegate/value convention of this family: out in rdi, the object in rsi).
kind_dispatch.signature: kind_dispatch(out, value, node, found, str_a, str_b, arg7, extra)

map_clear.behaviour: Re-shipped byte-identical from #3485: destroys every options-map node (both strings, sized-delete) and zeroes the buckets, the first node and the element count. 98 direct call sites in the binary.

move_assign.behaviour: std::string move-assignment (operator=(string&&)): the destination takes over the source's buffer (pointer, length and SSO buffer contents, with the small-string cases handled inline), the source is reset to empty, and the destination's old heap buffer is freed. Used by the name lookup to deliver the matched key or the dotted suffix into the caller's out-string.

name_lookup.behaviour: Finds a node by name in the table struct {list head +0x10, element count +0x18}: while the count is <= 20 a linear list walk (node+0x10 length, then memcmp on node+0x08), otherwise the hash-bucket find 0x60b84b0. On an exact match the key string is move-assigned into out (0x60b79e0) and the matched node's +0x28 field address is returned. On a miss the key is searched for '.' (0x43821e): no '.' or '.' at position 0 returns null. Otherwise the prefix key[0..pos] is searched the same way; when the prefix matches a node whose kind at +0xd0 is 0x13, 0x15 or 0x16, the suffix key[pos+1..] is move-assigned into out and the matched node's +0x28 field address is returned; a prefix match of any other kind returns null. Nodes are {next +0x00, name pointer +0x08, name length +0x10, kind +0xd0} and larger (the kind sits 0xa8 bytes past the returned +0x28 pointer).

no_equals.behaviour: Thin wrapper: forwards (out, value, node, key6, arg7) to resolve_no_equals 0x609b8a0 (note the argument shuffle: value moves to rsi, node to rdx) and returns out.

open_unknowns: The entry's top-level reach: it has exactly one direct call site (the recursive kind-0x16 call), so the caller that invokes it from outside this family reaches it through an indirect slot that is not pinned here; its argument roles at the top level (which object is the delegate, which table base8 points at) are therefore pinned only from the recursive call and the sibling callers of find_e70/no_equals.

The recursive kind-0x16 call passes the matched element's +0x20 field as the entry's base8 and the matched record as the descriptor: the flag-chain resolution there depends on the matched record's +0x28 first field (the offset added to base8) and its +0xb0/+0xb1 descriptor fields, which are not pinned from locally retained evidence; the model implements the chain generically and the tests cover it with synthetic records.

The global default name at 0x6508980 (a std::string; compared by length then memcmp in find_norm): its runtime value is set by static init, and the initializer was not located. The model parameterizes DEFAULT_NAME, defaulting to 'default' as the documented assumption.

The delegate vtable base address: the delegate's vtable slots 0x28/0x40/0x48/0x50/0x68/0x78 need a base, which was not pinned from locally retained evidence. Only the __libc_single_threaded GOT entry is pinned (see vtables.tsv).
The serializer 0x60ba600's per-kind serialization rules (25 jump-table cases, 0..0x18): a documented boundary carried over from #3485, not modeled internally.
The value struct's +0x48 shared_ptr control vtable base for this item's value objects (the Statistics control vptr 0x64d2f00 was pinned in #3440 for Statistics objects only).
Which construction paths install a non-null +0x28 delegate (the value struct's delegate slot).
The 0x609bcb0..0x609c782 routine, the second caller of kind_dispatch (0x609bec5) and of name_lookup (0x609be8a): a sibling Find-family routine whose body is not pinned here.

The 0x6080b10..0x6080dcc and 0x60818f0..0x6081d08 routines, the other callers of find_e70 (0x6080d09, 0x6081c2e) and no_equals (0x6080bbc, 0x60819a6): sibling Find-family routines whose bodies are not pinned here.
The 0x6098ad0..0x6099003 routine, the second caller of element_scan (0x6098b4e): a sibling routine whose body is not pinned here.

parser.behaviour: Re-shipped byte-identical from #3485; see that packet for the full contract (trim, outer-brace stripping, key=value loop over the delimiter set '={};' at 0x44b52b, brace-group values via 0x60b97f0, duplicate keys overwritten). Called from find_e70 at 0x6099fc5, from find_norm at 0x609a499 and from find_entry at 0x609e896.

resolve_no_equals.behaviour: The no-'=' path. The node's vtable slot 0x68 fills a string from (node, key6); that string is the key for the element scan 0x6096f40 over the node's +0x08 vector (0x30-byte elements), with a fresh empty string as the lookup out-string and an 8-byte slot that receives the matched element's +0x20 field. When the scan returns null, Status code 1 is built with msg1 'Could not find option: ' and msg2 = key6. Otherwise kind_dispatch 0x609b700 runs with (out, value, node, found, slot-0x68 string, lookup out-string, arg7, the element's +0x20 field).

shared_release.behaviour: Re-shipped from the earlier registry packets: releases a shared_ptr control block (use-count at +0x08). The entry calls it at 0x609b393 when the local value copy's control use-count is exactly 0x100000001 (single owner, weak count 1); otherwise the control is released through the object's vtable slots 0x10/0x18. 654 direct call sites and 36 direct jumps in the binary.

status_builder.behaviour: Re-shipped byte-identical from #3440: out = {code u8 +0x00, subcode u8 +0x01, severity u8 +0x02, msg char* +0x08}; the message is msg1, or msg1 + ': ' + msg2 when msg2 is non-empty. 847 direct call sites in the binary. The entry uses code 4 with msg1 = 'Option not changeable: ' + name5 and msg2 empty, and code 1 with msg1 = 'Could not find option: ' and msg2 = the searched name.

str_compare.behaviour: Lexicographic std::string comparison: memcmp over the shorter length; when the common prefix is equal the result is the signed length difference (len(a) - len(b), clamped to the int32 range by the 0x7fffffff comparison at the tail). The entry uses it only as an equality test (key6 vs the node-name-plus-dot string).

table_node.layout: {next +0x00, name pointer +0x08, name length +0x10, sub-struct pointer +0x28 (the name lookup returns the address of this field), kind u32 +0xd0, state +0xd4, flags +0xd8, flag byte +0xd9} (at least 0xda bytes)
table_node.notes: The kind values pinned here are 0x13, 0x15 and 0x16: 0x13 and 0x15 take the slot-0x50 call in kind_dispatch, 0x16 recurses into the entry, and the dotted name lookup admits only 0x13/0x15/0x16 prefixes. The state/flags fields (0xd4/0xd8) are the same fields the worker in #3485 skips on (states 4/5, 0x2000) -- this item does not re-pin their skipping here because name_lookup and kind_dispatch do not test them.

value_struct.layout: {u32 +0x00, u8 +0x04, std::string +0x08 (ptr/len/buf16), u32 +0x28, u8 +0x2c, u64 +0x30, 16 bytes +0x38, u64 +0x48} where +0x48 is a shared_ptr control block (use-count at +0x08, released via 0x5d35070 or vtable slots 0x10/0x18 when count is 0x100000001)
value_struct.notes: The +0x03 byte (the top byte of the +0x00 u32) gates find_e70's slot-0x28 call. The +0x04 byte is cleared in the entry's local copy when the descriptor's +0xb1 flag is set, and gates the entry's dispatch when that flag is clear.

zero_stub.behaviour: The default vtable slot-0x40 implementation: zeroes the 16-byte Status (code 0, the six status bytes 0, message null) and returns out. find_e70 compares a node's slot-0x40 against this address (lea at 0x609a0d7, the only lea reference to it in the binary) to decide whether to call the slot or zero out directly.
